import sqlite3

_conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:", check_same_thread=False)

def _to_dict(row):
    return dict(row) if row else None


def get_by_id(user_id: int) -> dict | None:
    return _to_dict(_conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,)).fetchone())


def find_by_email(email: str) -> dict | None:

"""Print the size and SHA-256 of a file as JSON. Usage: python scripts/digest.py --file PATH"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--file", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
data = Path(args.file).read_bytes()
print(json.dumps({"file": args.file, "bytes": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}))
"""Print a small JSON report for a name. Usage: python scripts/report.py --name NAME"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--name", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"name": args.name, "length": len(args.name),
                  "checksum": hashlib.sha256(args.name.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}))
"""Print a URL slug for a title as JSON. Usage: python scripts/slug.py --title TITLE"""

import argparse
import json
import re

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--title", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"slug": re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", args.title.lower()).strip("-")}))

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+import re
+from datetime import date
+
+from app.services import users
+
+_MONTHS = {
+    "january": 1,
+    "february": 2,
+    "march": 3,
+    "april": 4,
+    "may": 5,
+    "june": 6,
+    "july": 7,
+    "august": 8,
+    "september": 9,
+    "october": 10,
+    "november": 11,
+    "december": 12,
+}
+_MONTH_ABBR = {name[:3]: number for name, number in _MONTHS.items()}
+
+_ISO_RE = re.compile(r"(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})")
+_ABBR_RE = re.compile(r"(\d{1,2}) ([A-Za-z]{3}) (\d{4})")
+_MONTH_RE = re.compile(r"([A-Za-z]+) (\d{1,2}), (\d{4})")
+_DAY_FIRST_RE = re.compile(r"(\d{2})/(\d{2})/(\d{4})")
+
+
+def _valid_date(year: int, month: int, day: int) -> str | None:
+    """Return the ISO representation of a real calendar date, or None."""
+    try:
+        return date(year, month, day).isoformat()
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+
+
+def handle_normalize_date(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("date")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid date"}
+
+    text = raw.strip()
+
+    match = _ISO_RE.fullmatch(text)
+    if match:
+        year, month, day = (int(part) for part in match.groups())
+        iso = _valid_date(year, month, day)
+        return (200, {"date": iso}) if iso else (400, {"error": "invalid date"})
+
+    match = _ABBR_RE.fullmatch(text)
+    if match:
+        day, name, year = match.groups()
+        month = _MONTH_ABBR.get(name.lower())
+        if month is None:
+            return 400, {"error": "invalid date"}
+        iso = _valid_date(int(year), month, int(day))
+        return (200, {"date": iso}) if iso else (400, {"error": "invalid date"})
+
+    match = _MONTH_RE.fullmatch(text)
+    if match:
+        name, day, year = match.groups()
+        month = _MONTHS.get(name.lower())
+        if month is None:
+            return 400, {"error": "invalid date"}
+        iso = _valid_date(int(year), month, int(day))
+        return (200, {"date": iso}) if iso else (400, {"error": "invalid date"})
+
+    match = _DAY_FIRST_RE.fullmatch(text)
+    if match:
+        day, month, year = (int(part) for part in match.groups())
+        iso = _valid_date(year, month, day)
+        return (200, {"date": iso}) if iso else (400, {"error": "invalid date"})
+
+    return 400, {"error": "invalid date"}
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user

+import pytest
+
+from app.api.handlers import handle_normalize_date
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "raw,expected",
+    [
+        ("2024-03-05", "2024-03-05"),
+        ("5 Mar 2024", "2024-03-05"),
+        ("March 5, 2024", "2024-03-05"),
+        ("05/03/2024", "2024-03-05"),
+        ("  5 Mar 2024  ", "2024-03-05"),
+        ("29 Feb 2024", "2024-02-29"),
+        ("31 Dec 1999", "1999-12-31"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_normalize_date_ok(raw, expected):
+    assert handle_normalize_date({"date": raw}) == (200, {"date": expected})
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "params",
+    [
+        {},
+        {"date": None},
+        {"date": 20240305},
+        {"date": "2024-13-05"},
+        {"date": "2024-02-30"},
